messages:
ana: Heads-up — embargo window shifted for the benchmark briefings. New embargo is 2026-04-05 08:00 PT. Need quick runbook for the media rehearsal + final quote polish. @sam can you confirm which analysts are in the 8am slot?

sam: Got it. 8am PT list = 3 analysts (ICV, DataEdge, TechLedger). ICV said they need a short pre-brief doc.

lee: Planning to push the benchmark post at T+1 after embargo lifts. We should lock the quote string so copy team can prep social snippets.

ana: Copying proposed quote below — please comment inline. We want one tech-forward and one customer-focused variant.

ana: ```
"Redwood Inference dramatically reduces latency and unit costs for production LLMs, enabling teams to ship higher-value features at scale."
```

oliver: Agency prefers shorter headlines for press. Suggest: "New inference runtime halves token cost at production scale" — legal check needed for "halves" claim. @kate

kate: I can clear the phrasing by EOD if we have the benchmark methodology link and sample data. Can't approve absolute claims without the margin-of-error caveat.

sam: I'll send the sample slices to @kate and the analysts. Also looping in contact emails: jay@techwire, emma@datainsight — will ask for embargo compliance and confirm briefing times.

pressbot: Reminder — attach fact-check doc before 5pm PT to enable same-day approvals.

ana: Action items: 1) @sam share analyst pre-brief doc (ICV format) — due 12:30pm PT. 2) @oliver produce 2 headline variants + 3 social snippets — due 3pm PT. 3) @kate legal to review quote + methodology — due by 5pm PT. 4) @lee schedule T+1 post slot and CDN edge purge window.

oliver: I'll mock headlines now and post in this thread for fast feedback. :thumbsup:

sam: Quick Q — are we offering an embargoed demo link for press during briefings, or just slides?

ana: Demo link for analysts only (no external press demo). Slides + short recorded demo for press after embargo lift. We'll give analysts live access during their slot.

lee: For routing inbound leads from the briefings, we should tag them `_briefing_2026-04` in the CRM and auto-assign to AE team A. I'll add the exact mapping to the runbook.

ana: Perfect. We're tight on time — everyone, ping here when your item is posted. I'll compile a single fact-check doc and attach to the outreach email once approved.

sam: Posted analyst list + emails in thread. Sent sample data to @kate.

kate: Reviewed the methodology note — small wording tweak proposed in attached snippet. Approve quote with caveat: add "based on our test suite (see methodology)".

ana: New quote variant with legal tweak: 
"Redwood Inference reduces latency and unit costs for production LLMs, based on our test suite (see methodology)."

oliver: Love it. Adding a punchier headline and 3 tweet-length snippets now. Will upload by 2:45pm PT.

pressbot: Note: embargo metadata set to 2026-04-05T15:00Z (matches 08:00 PT). Automated embargo email scheduled for 07:50 PT on 2026-04-05.

ana: Thanks — closing loop. If anyone sees a blocker post your ping here. :sparkles:
